The nominal diameter of a triple-threaded square screw is 50 mm, while the pitch is 8 mm. It is used with a collar having an outer diameter of 100 mm and inner diameter as 65 mm. The coefficient of friction at the threaded surface as well as at the collar surface can be taken as 0.15. The screw is used to raise a load of 15 kN. Using the uniform wear theory for collar friction, calculate: (i) Torque required to raise the load; (ii) Torque required to lower the load; and (iii) Force required to raise the load, if applied at a radius of 500 mm.

Design a clamp coupling to transmit 30 kW at 100 r.p.m. The allowable shear stress for the shaft and key is 40 MPa and the number of bolts connecting the two halves are six. The permissible tensile stress for the bolts is 70 MPa. The coefficient of friction between the muff and the shaft surface may be taken as 0.3.
State the Hook’s law. Draw stress – strain curve for mild steel.

Helical compression spring having maximum load as 1000 N with maximum deflection of 30 mm. Spring index is 6 and maximum permissible shear stress for the spring wire is 400 MPa. Design the helical compression spring with modulus of rigidity as 84000 MPa.
Explain the design procedure of helical spring.
